user_goal.text: Identify the card name used for the user's most recent Amazon Prime membership payment.

benchmark_success.text: Native success requires the first end-state supervisor task to have status "success", its JSON-parsed answer (or raw answer on parse failure) to match "Wells Fargo" under the official answer comparator, and the changed-model list to be falsy.

checked_by.text: The released evaluate function derives task completion from the first supervisor task, compares its answer through TestTracker.answer, and checks models.changed_model_names() for falsity.

decisive_artifacts.question: Does the first active task have status "success", and does its parsed-or-raw answer match "Wells Fargo" under the official comparator?

decisive_artifacts.artifact: Retained start/end model snapshots or changed-model report
decisive_artifacts.question: Is models.changed_model_names() falsy?

success_if.text: The first end-state supervisor task has status "success".
The task answer, JSON-decoded when possible and otherwise used raw, matches "Wells Fargo" under the official answer comparator.
The retained model comparison reports no changed model names.

fail_if.text: No first active supervisor task exists, or its status is not "success".
The parsed-or-raw task answer does not match "Wells Fargo" under the official answer comparator.

undecided_if.text: Retained evidence omits or incompletely captures the end-state task record, answer, status, or model comparison needed to determine every native component.
